restart.note: Fresh start: no August catch-up debt. Rapid review is conditional on recall; do not delay the diagnostic to finish reading.
restart.capacity_rule: Launch: about 26 hours. Content weeks: 22-24 hours. If two weeks exceed capacity, cut optional reading/question volume and reconsider January using scored evidence.
restart.rest_rule: Sunday off in non-exam weeks. In scored FL weeks Friday is rest/light logistics; Sunday-Monday are protected review. Launch Friday is light and Monday finishes review.

workload_policy.budget_role: planned_hours is the weekly capacity budget, not a promise that every upper-bound estimate fits.
workload_policy.validation: Fail if the low estimate exceeds the budget. Show midpoint and upper-bound risks; never clamp estimates to fit.
workload_policy.execution: Protect exams, their review and sleep. If the budget is reached, stop new questions, finish their review next session, and replace lower-priority work rather than adding catch-up debt. Log actual time and replan if two weeks overrun.
workload_policy.maintenance: Chapter days add 15-30 minutes Anki/log maintenance. Operational mode blocks already include maintenance; exam/review days have no extra quota.
workload_policy.estimates: Mode ranges and question review allowances are planning assumptions, not measured completion times. The midpoint is a sensitivity check, not a statistical forecast.
